zh.title: Aegean任命Michalis Kouveliotis為執行長 Gerogiannis交接期間續任顧問
zh.summary: Aegean任命Michalis Kouveliotis接任執行長，Gerogiannis交接期間任顧問。
body: Aegean Airlines於2026年10月12日宣佈，Michalis Kouveliotis將立即接任執行長。他自2025年初起擔任副執行長，並曾任該航空公司的財務長逾20年。轉任副執行長後，他負責協調公司的各業務部門。
Dimitris Gerogiannis將在交接期間繼續擔任顧問，並負責監督Technical Base and Training Center。Aegean Airlines表示，Gerogiannis正結束其在公司領導層的一個篇章；他於2001年加入該航空公司。

en.title: Aegean names Michalis Kouveliotis CEO; Gerogiannis to advise during transition
en.summary: Aegean appoints Michalis Kouveliotis CEO; Gerogiannis will advise during the transition.
body: Aegean Airlines announced on October 12, 2026, that Michalis Kouveliotis will assume the CEO role immediately. He had served as Deputy CEO since early 2025 and previously served as the airline’s CFO for over 20 years. As Deputy CEO, he was responsible for coordinating the company’s business divisions.

Dimitris Gerogiannis will continue as an adviser during the transition, overseeing the Technical Base and Training Center. Aegean Airlines said Gerogiannis is concluding a chapter in the company’s executive leadership. He joined the carrier in 2001.

zh.title: 空中巴士公佈10月5日至9日股票回購交易
zh.summary: 空中巴士公佈10月5日至9日股票回購交易，計畫用於員工持股及股權薪酬
body: 空中巴士（Airbus SE）於10月12日發布資料，表示公司報告了10月5日至9日的股票回購交易。這些交易屬於空中巴士於9月11日宣佈的回購計畫，目的在支援未來員工持股計畫及以股權為基礎的薪酬計畫。
公司表示，回購計畫依據股東在2026年4月14日年度股東大會授予空中巴士董事會的權限執行，授權上限為已發行股本的10%。公告將公司股票交易代號列為AIR。

en.title: Airbus reports share buyback transactions for 5–9 October 2026
en.summary: Airbus reports 5–9 October share buybacks under an employee ownership and equity compensation programme.
body: Airbus SE said from Amsterdam on 12 October that it was reporting share buyback transactions for 5–9 October 2026. The company said the transactions form part of a programme announced on 11 September 2026. It stated that the programme is intended to support future employee share ownership plan activities and equity-based compensation plans.

Airbus said the programme is carried out under authority granted to its board by shareholders at the company’s annual general meeting on 14 April 2026. That authority permits repurchases of up to a maximum of 10% of issued share capital. The release identifies Airbus SE’s stock exchange symbol as AIR.

zh.title: 達美航空延後亞特蘭大—利雅德航線至2027年3月啟航
zh.summary: 達美航空將亞特蘭大至利雅德航線啟航延至2027年3月。
body: 達美航空（Delta Air Lines）將亞特蘭大至利雅德航線的啟航時間延至2027年3月。AeroTime報導指出，這條航線原將成為達美航空首條直飛沙烏地阿拉伯的客運服務。
報導指出，達美航空於2026年10月12日宣佈延後，當時距離原定10月23日啟航不到兩週。
AeroTime將這項延後描述為發生在沙烏地阿拉伯首都主要機場遭受致命攻擊之後。達美航空表示，正與政府及航空業夥伴保持聯繫，包括Saudia和Riyadh Air，並持續監看事態發展。

en.title: Delta postpones Atlanta–Riyadh launch until March 2027
en.summary: Delta Air Lines postpones its Atlanta–Riyadh launch until March 2027.
body: Delta Air Lines has postponed the launch of its Atlanta–Riyadh flights until March 2027, AeroTime reported. The report says the route would be Delta’s first direct passenger service to Saudi Arabia.

Delta announced the delay on October 12, 2026, less than two weeks before service was due to begin on October 23. AeroTime described the postponement as coming after deadly attacks on the Saudi capital’s main airport.
Delta said it remained in contact with government and aviation partners, including Saudia and Riyadh Air, while monitoring developments.
